verdict.rationale: Docusign's own pages claim configurable workflows, a drag-and-drop editor for contract processes in CLM, and IAM workflow automation. A risk-based verification workflow adjusts automatically based on a risk assessment, and workflow actions can be triggered through IAM tools via MCP. None of the evidence shows a user-defined event→action rule engine, such as triggers on envelope completion or webhook-driven rules, so the story is only implied by marketing language. Missing for 10: explicit event-trigger rule configuration, documentation of event types and actions, webhook/event-notification evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
